verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly list official TypeScript, Go, and PHP SDKs (with Python coming soon) that are typed clients mapping to the Core API reference, plus a sandbox environment for safe automated testing and getting-started API token guidance — a solid AI-native/agentic development story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and no OpenAPI spec found (probe returned 404s), and Python SDK is not yet available.
